system.description: Once per turn, when a hostile creature enters the space of a Web Anchor, the silk instantly constricts, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Grappled in place by the webs until the beginning of their next turn. Beginning at 11th level, a creature that fails their saving throw is instead Restrained in place, remaking their saving throws at the end of each of their turns, ending the Restrained condition on a success.
